name: Video Guide Skill
description: Produce professional user-guide MP4 videos from screen recordings and a recipe JSON. Supports narration (Edge TTS), animated HUD overlays, zoom annotations, background music, and SRT captions.
author: Krishna Vikash ERP

tools.name: validate_recipe
tools.description: Validate a Video Guide recipe JSON without rendering. Runs TTS synthesis and timing checks. Returns warnings and plan text. Always call this before render_guide to catch overlap issues.

recipe_json.description: Full recipe JSON string (or stringified dict).

tools.name: render_guide
tools.description: Render a complete user-guide MP4 (with narration, HUD overlays, zoom annotations, background music) from a recipe JSON. Also produces an .srt caption file.

output_path.description: Absolute path for the output .mp4 file.

export_srt.description: Whether to export a .srt subtitle file alongside the mp4.

tools.name: extract_frames
tools.description: Extract frames from a screen recording at a given FPS (default 3). Frames are saved as 0001_frame.png, 0002_frame.png … Use frame paths in recipe's timeline_mapping steps.

video_path.description: Absolute path to the input screen recording (.mp4, .mov, .mkv).

fps.description: Frames per second to extract. 3 is recommended for UI walkthroughs.

output_dir.description: Directory to write frames into. Defaults to <video_dir>/<video_stem>_frames/.
